fields.help_en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `metricCategory` field in the `Labels` response parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114916.html operation

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not bind security groups to instances. The check items include whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a regular request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is directly performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
